% pdflatex -halt-on-error -output-directory=<temp> circuitikz-passive-label-anchors.tex
% Probe installed CircuitikZ as shipped: no replacements of its label macros.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\makeatletter
\def\proberadius{2}
\def\ProbePoint#1#2#3{%
  \pgf@process{\pgfpointdiff{\pgfpointanchor{B}{center}}{\pgfpointanchor{#2}{#3}}}%
  \typeout{P|#1|#3|\number\pgf@x|\number\pgf@y}}
% id, text, fixed bipole, alignment, side, direction, coordinate transform,
% component options (mirror/invert), ambient pen
\newcommand\Probe[9]{%
  \begingroup\ctikzset{label/align=#4}%
  \setbox0=\hbox{#2}%
  \edef\probeex{\number\dimexpr1ex\relax}\edef\probeem{\number\dimexpr1em\relax}%
  \typeout{I|#1|#3|#4|#5|#8}%
  \typeout{T|#1|\number\wd0|\number\ht0|\number\dp0}%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{scope}[#7,line width=#9]
      \typeout{F|#1|\probeex|\probeem|\number\baselineskip|\number\pgflinewidth}%
      \pgfgettransformentries{\ma}{\mb}{\mc}{\md}{\mx}{\my}%
      \typeout{M|#1|\ma|\mb|\mc|\md|\number\dimexpr\mx\relax|\number\dimexpr\my\relax}%
      \pgf@process{\pgfpointpolarxy{#6}{\proberadius}}%
      \typeout{E|#1|\number\pgf@x|\number\pgf@y}%
      \ifnum#5>0 \draw (0,0) to[#3,n=B,#8,l^={#2}] (#6:\proberadius);
      \else      \draw (0,0) to[#3,n=B,#8,l_={#2}] (#6:\proberadius);\fi
      \pgf@process{\pgfpointdiff{\pgfpointanchor{Bstart}{center}}{\pgfpointanchor{Bend}{center}}}%
      \typeout{D|#1|\number\pgf@x|\number\pgf@y|\ctikzgetdirection{B}|\ctikzgetdirection{Blabel}|\ctikzgetanchor{B}{label}}%
      \pgfmathsetlength\pgf@x{\ctikzvalof{label distance}}%
      \typeout{L|#1|\number\pgf@x}%
    \end{scope}
    \pgf@process{\pgfpointanchor{B}{center}}\typeout{C|#1|\number\pgf@x|\number\pgf@y}%
    \ProbePoint{#1}{Blabel}{text}\ProbePoint{#1}{Blabel}{mid}\ProbePoint{#1}{Blabel}{base}%
    \ProbePoint{#1}{Blabel}{south west}\ProbePoint{#1}{Blabel}{north east}%
  \end{tikzpicture}\par\endgroup}
\makeatother
\begin{document}

\ifdefined\FullAngleSweep
  \def\proberadius{2.5}
  \foreach \angle in {0,...,359}{%
    \ifodd\angle\relax\def\sideA{-1}\def\sideB{1}\else\def\sideA{1}\def\sideB{-1}\fi
    \Probe{s\angle}{45}{R}{straight}{\sideA}{\angle}{}{}{.4pt}
    \Probe{r\angle}{-45}{C}{rotate}{\sideB}{\angle}{}{}{.7pt}
    \Probe{a\angle}{123}{R}{smart}{\sideA}{\angle}{}{}{1pt}}
\fi
